display.name: 后端诊断
display.description: 按指标采样含义确定请求范围。数据源：test4 VictoriaMetrics。

display.name: Prefill 运行与排队请求
display.description:
指标含义
调度器当前运行与排队请求，按原始 rank 分线，未对复制 rank 求总和。

Y 轴单位
请求

曲线与范围
DCU 环境；实例、节点或 rank 分线展示，复制数据不直接相加。

时间口径
速率和分位数使用最近 1 分钟窗口；状态与容量是观测时刻值。默认 1 小时，15 秒刷新。

零值与空白
正常有效的零值保留；缺样、过期、重启、计数异常、无有效分母或无直方图样本时留空，不补零。请求范围以各指标说明为准。

spec.query: (sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))))

(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-prefill"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))))
